text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to establish an accessible loading zone on the east side of Perth Avenue. The loading zone will provide curb-side access for Wheel-Trans vehicles picking up or dropping off patrons. The loading zone is required from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. daily and will result in the loss of two on-street parking spaces during this period and no impact to overnight permit parking.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone operating from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. daily on the east side of Perth Avenue, from a point 35.5 metres north of Ernest Avenue to a point 11 metres further north.
